[[User:GuanYu79]] has brought up a good point regarding character names. There are some characters whose articles are not at their full names. For example, Min Farshaw should be at Elmindreda Farshaw. 

Most articles are at the name where you would expect them to be. Redirects can be used to link to the more common name and the characters' intro section can reflect the different names. Also, [[Help:Style guide#People]] states that "Articles on people should be located at the expected full name."

Below is a list of the ones that I have found as well as their possible renames. Please add any more that I may have missed. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:38, December 1, 2010 (UTC)

==List==
*<s>[[Min Farshaw]] => Elmindreda Farshaw</s>
*<s>[[Lan Mandragoran]] => al'Lan Mandragoran</s>
*<s>[[Nynaeve al'Meara]] => el'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran</s>
*<s>[[Faile Bashere]] => Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara</s>
*<s>[[Davram Bashere]] => Davram t'Ghaline Bashere</s>
*<s>[[Deira Bashere]] => Deira ni Ghaline t'Bashere</s>
*<s>[[Tenobia Kazadi]] => Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi</s>
*<s>[[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] => Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag</s>
*<s>[[Jain Farstrider]] => Jain Charin</s>
*[[Egeanin Tamarath]] => Leiwin Shipless

*I would support all of the changes. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:38, December 1, 2010 (UTC)

:I also agree to these. I think we should try and keep as consistent as possible over actual names. Zarine should also be included and a merger between Noal and Jain and perhaps Padan Fain and Mordreth??--[[User:GuanYu79|GuanYu79]] 01:17, December 1, 2010 (UTC)

==Update==
I changed all but one of the above items. For Egeanin, her name change was more stylistic in a way. She was "told" that was her name, it wasn't something she got by marriage or "elevation" as in Fortuona's case. I think that her being at the current page name is fine. I also changed Jain Farstrider to Jain Charin. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 07:26, November 7, 2012 (UTC)
